gear.desc:wood_pickaxe: Planks on two sticks. The least tool that breaks stone, and it brings stone away only as rubble.
gear.desc:wood_axe: Two planks shaped to a head on a stick. Timber yields to any edge, and even this one lifts a log whole.
gear.desc:wood_shovel: A plank blade on two sticks. Soil, sand and snow come away faster with it than by hand.
gear.desc:wood_sword: Planks cut to a blade on a stick. Enough for small feeders. A great feeder cannot be killed with wood.
gear.desc:wood_bow: A plank stave strung with plant fibre. It throws the flint arrows we cut at the workbench.
gear.desc:stone_pickaxe: Knapped rubble on a haft. The rock that iron lies in yields to it.
gear.desc:stone_axe: A head of knapped rubble lashed to a stick. Heavier than a plank head and quicker through a trunk.
gear.desc:stone_shovel: Flat rubble knapped to a blade. It cuts turf and clay, and gravel turned with it sometimes gives up flint.
gear.desc:stone_sword: Knapped rubble set along a stick for an edge. Anything harder than stone turns it.
gear.desc:stone_bow: A stick stave weighted with knapped rubble at both tips and strung with fibre. It throws harder than the plank bow.
gear.desc:iron_pickaxe: Iron from a wood fire, beaten on the anvil. The rock round Hīrak breaks under it, and the gem comes out whole.
gear.desc:iron_axe: Iron on a stick. Oak, pine and the other trees of the living ground come down to it quickly.
gear.desc:iron_shovel: Beaten iron for a blade. Turf, sand, clay and snow all move faster under it than under knapped stone.
gear.desc:iron_sword: Two iron bars drawn out to a blade. Iron is the last metal a crew wins without killing anything large.
gear.desc:iron_bow: A stick stave tipped with iron at both ends and strung with fibre. Barbed heads for it come off the same anvil.
gear.desc:iron_staff: Three sticks, a crystal and two pieces of iron, lines cut along the wood. The soft iron seat soaks up part of a throw.
gear.desc:iron_totem: An iron billet between two carved bones with shade flesh bound on. What forms on that food is a green lump with a thorn.
gear.desc:iron_melee_0: Beaten iron over the head. Thorn and tooth of the common kinds turn on it, as an edge turns on anything harder.
gear.desc:iron_melee_1: Iron plate front and back. The old stores had harness like this on frames, and Nihirakka took their bodies from it.
gear.desc:iron_melee_2: Iron plate from shin to thigh. Helm, cuirass and greaves together take more bars than the anvil did.
gear.desc:iron_ranged_0: A hood of sheep or boar hide, with iron riveted at the brow and over the ears.
gear.desc:iron_ranged_1: A hide jerkin with iron plates over the chest, cut and riveted at the anvil. The arms stay free to draw.
gear.desc:iron_ranged_2: Leggings of sheep or boar hide, with iron riveted at the knee.
gear.desc:iron_magic_0: An iron band with crystal fibre wound round it, for someone who drives a staff.
gear.desc:iron_magic_1: Crystal fibre over thin iron. Fibre round crystal is a cut line made up as cloth, worn by those who drive crystal.
gear.desc:iron_magic_2: Strips of iron hung from the waist under crystal fibre. The iron is from the upper rock, worked by fire.
gear.desc:iron_summon_0: Iron over the face with bone set in it at the cheeks, made on the Line Frame.
gear.desc:iron_summon_1: Bone set in an iron frame across the shoulders. Those who carry a totem wear this harness.
gear.desc:iron_summon_2: Bands of iron and bone wound round each leg, the last piece of a totem bearer's harness.
gear.desc:lumenite_pickaxe: A head of the gem, cleaved to shape on the anvil's edge. Jalit ore and Black Glass both yield to it.
gear.desc:lumenite_axe: The gem cleaved to a wedge and set on a stick. Its edge is finer than iron's, and timber parts in front of it.
gear.desc:lumenite_shovel: A blade of clear gem, cleaved flat. Sand and gravel give way to it faster than to iron.
gear.desc:lumenite_sword: Hīrak takes a finer edge than iron and splits under a blow from the side. It is cleaved along its joints, with no forge.
gear.desc:lumenite_bow: Hīrak tips, a stick stave, a fibre string. Kammār calls the gem a stone: it takes an edge and no fire touches it.
gear.desc:lumenite_staff: A seat of the gem holds the crystal, and less of the throw is lost than in iron. Rehakār calls Hīrak crystal past use.
gear.desc:lumenite_totem: Hīrak between two carved bones with shade flesh on them. A point of the gem's colour forms there and stays by the hand.
gear.desc:lumenite_melee_0: Cleaved plates of the gem riveted over a cap. In its rock the gem is clear and gives a cold light.
gear.desc:lumenite_melee_1: A cuirass of cleaved Hīrak. The gem lies low in the living ground and rarely, and this piece takes the most of it.
gear.desc:lumenite_melee_2: Hīrak plates down both legs. The gem is too hard for a low feeder to eat.
gear.desc:lumenite_ranged_0: Hide with Hīrak set at the brow. The gem was dug with an iron pick and came out of its rock whole.
gear.desc:lumenite_ranged_1: A hide jerkin with cleaved gem over the chest. Kankāl's carcass was full of this gem.
gear.desc:lumenite_ranged_2: Hide leggings set with Hīrak at knee and shin. Of all the hardnesses, Hīrak is the one that is no metal.
gear.desc:lumenite_magic_0: A band of the gem with crystal fibre round it. The gem has set so far that no hand can drive it.
gear.desc:lumenite_magic_1: Hīrak sewn under a robe of crystal fibre. The fibre carries what the arm drives, as lines in a hearthstone do.
gear.desc:lumenite_magic_2: Crystal fibre over cleaved plates of the gem, hung from the waist.
gear.desc:lumenite_summon_0: Cleaved gem and bone over the face, set on the Line Frame.
gear.desc:lumenite_summon_1: Plates of Hīrak across the shoulders, with bone set between.
gear.desc:lumenite_summon_2: Hīrak and bone wound round the legs. The bone is what was left in the pot, and every kill leaves some.
gear.desc:cinder_pickaxe: Jalit beaten to a pick. Antar ore in the hollow yields to this and to no softer pick.
gear.desc:cinder_axe: Jalit, hafted for felling. The ore came out of the deep rock still warm.
gear.desc:cinder_shovel: No fire a person lights moves Jalit ore. Maruhar's remains in a ring of stone loosened it, and this blade is the bar.
gear.desc:cinder_sword: Iron that ran molten with the deep rock and set again there all at once. The first metal that cost us a great kill.
gear.desc:cinder_bow: Jalit at the tips and fibre between. Kammār sells Jalit arrows for it once she has the bars.
gear.desc:cinder_staff: Jalit for the seat, crystal at the head. A harder seat loses less of the throw, and a harder throw costs the arm more.
gear.desc:cinder_totem: A billet of Jalit between two carved bones. What forms there takes its body from the billet: an ember in the air.
gear.desc:cinder_melee_0: A Jalit helm. The ore was cut beside the molten rock and was warm in the hand.
gear.desc:cinder_melee_1: Front and back plate of Jalit. Kammār can shape a bar of it and cannot make one.
gear.desc:cinder_melee_2: Greaves of Jalit. Every metal from this one up costs a great kill, and this one cost Maruhar.
gear.desc:cinder_ranged_0: Jalit riveted over a hide hood. The bar came out of a furnace that Maruhar's remains keep working.
gear.desc:cinder_ranged_1: A jerkin of hide and Jalit. The metal came out of the lowest rock but one, where the molten rock runs.
gear.desc:cinder_ranged_2: Jalit at knee and shin over hide. The ore needs a Hīrak pick, and the Black Glass beside it yields to the same.
gear.desc:cinder_magic_0: A Jalit circlet wound with crystal fibre, from a bar that ran in Maruhar's furnace.
gear.desc:cinder_magic_1: Crystal fibre on a Jalit frame. A badly laid line leaks into the arm, so the fibre is laid on the Line Frame.
gear.desc:cinder_magic_2: At the waist, Jalit strips under crystal fibre. Iron that set at that depth and heat sits harder than the iron above it.
gear.desc:cinder_summon_0: A mask of Jalit set with bone. The bar was loosened in a bed of remains ringed with Deep Rock.
gear.desc:cinder_summon_1: A mantle of bone in Jalit. A totem's bearer has one small feeder under the hand, and the full harness allows another.
gear.desc:cinder_summon_2: Jalit bands and bone bound at the shin. The furnace that loosened the bar draws feeders for as long as it stands.
gear.desc:umbrite_pickaxe: Antar, the metal of the hollow's rock. With it a crew can take Tala ore, lower down near the standing water.
gear.desc:umbrite_axe: In the hollow, Fungus Stem comes down to an Antar head as a trunk does above.
gear.desc:umbrite_shovel: Antar beaten flat for digging. Fungal Turf lifts with it. The Hollow Rock under the turf needs a pick.
gear.desc:umbrite_sword: Nobody can say whether Antar is iron. Nobody here has seen it soft before it set. It is harder than Jalit.
gear.desc:umbrite_bow: Antar at the tips, fibre for the string. Arrows cross a ward freely, so a bow kills from inside a held place.
gear.desc:umbrite_staff: Lines run down the wood from grip to head, where the crystal sits on Antar, the first metal cut under the world.
gear.desc:umbrite_totem: Shade flesh bound to two carved bones, with Antar between. A small dark flier forms on the food and keeps to the bearer.
gear.desc:umbrite_melee_0: Antar over the head. The metal cost the first gate, and Kankāl before it.
gear.desc:umbrite_melee_1: A cuirass of Antar. The hollow has rock for a floor and a roof, and this metal lies at every height between.
gear.desc:umbrite_melee_2: Antar greaves. Kammār sells the bars once Guhamāt is dead, since its carcass is full of the metal.
gear.desc:umbrite_ranged_0: A hood of hide and Antar. The hide is from the living ground and the metal from under it.
gear.desc:umbrite_ranged_1: Hide and Antar over the chest. A Jalit pick is the softest that takes the ore.
gear.desc:umbrite_ranged_2: Antar riveted over hide at the knee. The ore ran in Maruhar's furnace, in the same bed as Jalit.
gear.desc:umbrite_magic_0: Antar wound with crystal fibre. Crystal stands in the hollow and fills its geodes, and none of it there has set to gem.
gear.desc:umbrite_magic_1: Antar plates under crystal fibre, laid on the Line Frame. No householder lives where this metal is cut.
gear.desc:umbrite_magic_2: Antar strips under crystal fibre, hung from the waist. The bar came up from the hollow through the first gate.
gear.desc:umbrite_summon_0: Bone and Antar over the face. The shade flesh on a totem's bones is from Tama, a kind bodied in the dark of the hollow.
gear.desc:umbrite_summon_1: Across the shoulders, bone set in Antar. The Antar ran in the same furnace as Jalit.
gear.desc:umbrite_summon_2: Antar and bone bound round each leg. The metal is from the hollow, and the bone is what was left in the pot.
gear.desc:noctrium_pickaxe: Tala, the hollow's metal from low down. This is the pick that opens Ākās ore on the islands.
gear.desc:noctrium_axe: Tala on a felling haft. It is the hollow's metal again, cut lower down and set harder.
gear.desc:noctrium_shovel: A Tala blade. The ore lay below Antar, near the floor of the hollow, and came out under an Antar pick.
gear.desc:noctrium_sword: Maruhar's remains leave Tala ore as it was. Guhamāt's remains loosened the bar this blade came from.
gear.desc:noctrium_bow: Bars of Tala came out of Jīmūt's carcass. This bow has them at its tips, with a fibre string.
gear.desc:noctrium_staff: A Tala seat behind the crystal. A staff throws as hard as its seat, and this metal is harder than Antar.
gear.desc:noctrium_totem: Tala between two carved bones. A small lit fungus cap forms on the shade flesh and goes for other feeders.
gear.desc:noctrium_melee_0: A helm of Tala. Kammār counts it a metal apart from Antar and sells it as one.
gear.desc:noctrium_melee_1: Tala over chest and back. The ore lies in the lower half of the hollow, down to the standing water.
gear.desc:noctrium_melee_2: Greaves of Tala, loosened in Guhamāt's furnace. That furnace burns on and works while its owner is away.
gear.desc:noctrium_ranged_0: Tala at the brow of a hide hood. The ore came from beside the hollow's standing water.
gear.desc:noctrium_ranged_1: A hide jerkin plated with Tala. Feeders are up at every hour in the hollow, and the ore was cut among them.
gear.desc:noctrium_ranged_2: Tala at knee and shin. The bars ran in a bed of Guhamāt's remains ringed with Hollow Rock.
gear.desc:noctrium_magic_0: A Tala band wound with crystal fibre. The fibre is the same path as a cut line, made up as cloth.
gear.desc:noctrium_magic_1: Rehakār sells the crystal fibre in this robe. The Tala under it is ours, from the hollow.
gear.desc:noctrium_magic_2: Crystal fibre over Tala, from the waist down. Worn with the rest of the set, it adds to what a staff does.
gear.desc:noctrium_summon_0: Tala and bone over the face. The bearer of a Tala totem walks with a lit cap at the hand.
gear.desc:noctrium_summon_1: Bone from the pot, set in Tala across the shoulders.
gear.desc:noctrium_summon_2: Tala and bone round the legs, the last of the harness.
gear.desc:aether_pickaxe: Ākās, the common metal of the islands. It takes Patik ore, the same metal with crystal grown through it.
gear.desc:aether_axe: Island Log comes down to this Ākās head, where the hour does not move.
gear.desc:aether_shovel: Island Soil and Island Turf lift with this Ākās blade.
gear.desc:aether_sword: Harder than anything the living ground gives but Gahan. We read hardness as age, so this Ākās blade would be old.
gear.desc:aether_bow: The islands' commonest metal at both tips, strung with fibre. Guhamāt's furnace ran the bars.
gear.desc:aether_staff: From Ākās up, a seat is hard enough that a throw is not spent on the first body it meets.
gear.desc:aether_totem: Two carved bones and a billet of Ākās. On this one a small white flier forms.
gear.desc:aether_melee_0: An Ākās helm. Feeders are up at every hour on the islands, as in the hollow, since neither has a sun.
gear.desc:aether_melee_1: Chest plate of Ākās, the commonest metal on the islands overhead. A gate is the only way to it.
gear.desc:aether_melee_2: Ākās greaves. On the islands a fall off the last ground does not land, and the faller is back on the footing, hurt.
gear.desc:aether_ranged_0: Hide with Ākās at the brow. It was cut in a light that never changes.
gear.desc:aether_ranged_1: Ākās over the chest, riveted to hide. Of all the picks, Tala is the softest that takes this ore.
gear.desc:aether_ranged_2: Leggings of hide and Ākās. The ore was cut over a drop that never lands.
gear.desc:aether_magic_0: An Ākās circlet in crystal fibre. The crystal of the islands is pale, from the lees of whatever fed there.
gear.desc:aether_magic_1: A robe of crystal fibre over Ākās. A true line wastes less of the arm, and the Line Frame lays this fibre true.
gear.desc:aether_magic_2: The gate to the islands was built round Jīmūt's remains, and through it came the Ākās in this skirt.
gear.desc:aether_summon_0: Ratan's body held bars of Ākās. One went into this mask, set with bone.
gear.desc:aether_summon_1: Bone and Ākās over the shoulders. The ore lies in island rock, in more veins than iron has below.
gear.desc:aether_summon_2: Wraps of Ākās and bone. The bars came up from the islands through the second gate.
gear.desc:prism_pickaxe: Patik neither splits like crystal nor bends like metal. It takes Gahan rock, which nothing of the living ground cuts.
gear.desc:prism_axe: A Patik axe head. The crystal that runs through the metal shows along the edge.
gear.desc:prism_shovel: Only Ratan's remains loosen Patik ore, in a ring of Island Rock. This blade is that bar beaten flat.
gear.desc:prism_sword: The islands' metal with crystal grown all through it. The crystal kinds there feed on its seams.
gear.desc:prism_bow: A Patik-tipped stave strung with fibre. Kuranga carried bars of this metal in its body.
gear.desc:prism_staff: Crystal at the head, and crystal through the Patik seat behind it. The throw goes on through whatever it hits first.
gear.desc:prism_totem: A lit splinter forms on this one, from the Patik billet between the bones.
gear.desc:prism_melee_0: Patik over the head. Old crystal is as hard as gem and splits as gem does, and this metal has it all through.
gear.desc:prism_melee_1: Patik plate. The ore yields to an Ākās pick and to nothing softer.
gear.desc:prism_melee_2: Patik down both legs. Gahan is the one metal harder, and a Patik pick is what reaches it.
gear.desc:prism_ranged_0: Patik riveted over a hide hood. The ore lies in seams in island rock.
gear.desc:prism_ranged_1: Patik plates riveted to a hide jerkin. The anvil works this metal once Ratan's furnace has run it.
gear.desc:prism_ranged_2: Hide leggings set with Patik at the knee, from the islands overhead.
gear.desc:prism_magic_0: Patik under crystal fibre at the brow. The crystal in the metal is as old as the metal.
gear.desc:prism_magic_1: The Line Frame keeps the fibre at an even tension as it is laid over these Patik plates.
gear.desc:prism_magic_2: Patik under crystal fibre, from the waist down, laid true on the Line Frame.
gear.desc:prism_summon_0: A Patik mask with bone at the cheeks. The crystal through the metal shows on its face.
gear.desc:prism_summon_1: A mantle of Patik and bone. It goes with a Patik totem, whose feeder is a lit splinter.
gear.desc:prism_summon_2: Patik and bone wound round the legs. Both gates had to stand before this ore could be cut.
gear.desc:eclipse_pickaxe: Gahan, from the lowest rock of all. It breaks any rock that lies over the floor. It does not mark the floor.
gear.desc:eclipse_axe: Gahan hafted for felling. Iron set as hard as anything sets here, with old lees through it.
gear.desc:eclipse_shovel: Gahan beaten flat on two sticks. The ore lies on the floor in thin veins, one to a stretch of ground.
gear.desc:eclipse_sword: A Gahan blade, violet like Chandasāvak. Some of us say that kind is made of this ore.
gear.desc:eclipse_bow: Gahan at the tips and fibre for the string. Nihān's body was full of Gahan bars.
gear.desc:eclipse_staff: The hardest seat there is: Gahan, under the crystal. Its throw passes through more than one body.
gear.desc:eclipse_totem: Gahan between two carved bones. What forms is a dark four-legged thing with pale tines, a hand high.
gear.desc:eclipse_melee_0: A Gahan helm. The ore gives a violet light where it lies.
gear.desc:eclipse_melee_1: No metal we have found is harder than the Gahan in this plate.
gear.desc:eclipse_melee_2: Plate for the legs, of Gahan. Of the ten hardnesses this is the last.
gear.desc:eclipse_ranged_0: Hide over the head, with Gahan riveted at the brow. The metal has old lees set all through it.
gear.desc:eclipse_ranged_1: A jerkin of hide and Gahan. Only a Patik pick takes the ore.
gear.desc:eclipse_ranged_2: Leggings of hide and Gahan. To dig the floor rock, a crew first needed both gates.
gear.desc:eclipse_magic_0: Crystal fibre round a Gahan band. Lees set through the metal, and crystal laid over it.
gear.desc:eclipse_magic_1: Kuranga's furnace ran the Gahan in this robe, and nothing else would.
gear.desc:eclipse_magic_2: Gahan strips under crystal fibre, hung from the waist. The anvil shaped the strips and the Line Frame laid the fibre.
gear.desc:eclipse_summon_0: A Gahan mask set with bone. The Cairn Key is made of this metal, because nothing softer holds its charge.
gear.desc:eclipse_summon_1: Gahan across the shoulders, set with bone for one who carries a totem.
gear.desc:eclipse_summon_2: Strips of Gahan with bone between them, bound from knee to ankle.
gear.desc:cairn_edge: A sword from the store under the Cairn, which Nihān had eaten into. It reaches further than any blade we make.
gear.desc:cairn_bow: A bow that came out of Nihān with the rest of the store it had eaten. Nothing we make throws as hard.
gear.desc:cairn_staff: A staff from the base under the Cairn, taken out of Nihān. Its throw goes through more than one body.
gear.desc:cairn_totem: A totem whose head is a lamp from the Cairn's housing. A point of yellow light forms on it.
gear.desc:arrow: A flint head on a stick, with grouse feather. The softest of the five heads.
gear.desc:barbed_arrow: Barbed iron on a stick, fletched with feather. Nihirakka leave these behind, from the stored arrows they ate.
gear.desc:ember_arrow: A Jalit head, fletched with feather. It comes off the anvil holding the heat of the deep.
gear.desc:void_arrow: An Antar head, with Moth Dust on the shaft where feather would be.
gear.desc:prism_arrow: A Patik head on a stick, fletched with feather. The hardest head we make.
gear.desc:hide_0: A cap of sheep or boar hide, cut at the workbench. It turns little.
gear.desc:hide_1: A vest of hide, cut at the workbench from the first sheep and boar a crew brings down.
gear.desc:hide_2: Hide trousers, cut at the workbench. The cap, vest and trousers worn together let a body move a little quicker.
gear.desc:cutter_saw: A two-handled steel saw for broken root-wood, its middle teeth stripped. The end teeth fell timber faster than any axe.
mod.desc:keen: The edge closed to a single line, with no flaw anywhere along it.
mod.desc:savage: Quenched in lees, or passed once through a feeder. It loosens a little where it cuts.
mod.desc:swift: Less metal went into it than its shape suggests. It comes round quicker.
mod.desc:heavy: Dense, with more metal in it than its size. It hits harder and swings slower.
mod.desc:dull: The bar had half set before the last blows, and the edge never closed.
mod.desc:blessed: It set all at once, in one working, with no soft place in it. The born call that favour.
mod.desc:warding: The plate is thickest where blows land.
mod.desc:stalwart: It set dense throughout, so it turns more and weighs more.
mod.desc:brittle: Hammered after it had set. It has cracks too fine to see.
mod.desc:arcane: Its grain runs one way from hand to head, and a line cut along it leaks less.
mod.desc:radiant: Old lees has set into the metal, as in Gahan ore, and shows as a faint cold light.
mod.desc:menacing: A grain of a strong kill's lees is in it. Where the bearer strikes, it loosens a little.
mod.desc:vital: A body wearing it takes more harm before it gives out.
mod.desc:fleet: The legs carry a body a little faster while it is worn.
mod.desc:lucky: Kills made by its bearer give up a little more, and more blows go in deep.
